summary.value: plugins/file/commands is a container with no direct source files that aggregates 20 complete file-plugin subcommands. Responsibilities split into workspace file operations (create/delete/edit/rename/view/tree/search), git operations (init/commit/diff/history/restore), bottom-up knowledge pipeline (bottomup.generate/summarize/enrich/summary), encrypted file sharing (upload/download via Nostr/Blossom NIP-44/naddr), and help. Bottomup commands share CLI/web adaptation, inherited context, SHA-256 hash caching, validated coverage/compact-summary checks, and plan/draft/revise/accept lifecycle with renderers modal UI for diff/preview and accept/decline; file/git commands follow validate workspace containment -> execute filesystem/git/ripgrep -> adapt to CLI text or web tree rendering. Cross-cutting support via shared for workspace-root resolution, path validation, git/IGNORE filtering, unified diff generation, Blossom transfer, and breadcrumb rendering. Coverage is complete for this directory and all listed children with no missing or stale summaries.

enrichment.directorySummary: Aggregation boundary beneath the file plugin's centralized dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and registration (init.ts) — groups the 20 file/git/bottom-up/transfer/help subcommands into cohesive families without owning logic itself. Provides the structural seam where adapter dispatch fans out to child implementations, while file/git commands share validate-containment → execute → adapt and bottomup commands share inherited context, hash-cache, coverage validation, and plan/draft/accept modal lifecycle via shared/ and per-command renderers.
